title: Ronaldo SIUUU
blurb: Cristiano Ronaldo has explained that the cry is simply the Spanish sí, meaning yes, picked up in his Real Madrid years and stretched to breaking point. It is a wonderfully mundane origin for the most imitated sound in world football. Every schoolyard, every FIFA lobby, every child who has ever jumped, spun and landed with their arms out after scoring anything at all. Less a word than a formal declaration of superiority, and it works because it is impossible to perform modestly. Play it after any victory, however small, and commit fully to the landing.
